parameters.name: CheckRemainingSiteQuota
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to filter plan instances that have remaining site quota. Valid values:

- **true**: Filters plan instances that have remaining site quota.
- **false**: Queries all plan instances under the user.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The plan instance ID. You can obtain this value by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number settings for paging. Default value: **1**. Valid values: **1 to 100000**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: PlanType
parameters.description:
The plan type. Valid values:

- normal: fixed edition plan
- enterprise: enterprise edition plan

parameters.name: RemainingExpireDays
parameters.description: Queries plan instances whose remaining validity period is within the specified number of days. The value must be a positive integer. Unit: days.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sort field. By default, results are sorted by purchase time. Valid values:

- **CreateTime**: Purchase time.
- **ExpireTime**: Expiration time.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:

- **asc**: Ascending order.
- **desc**: Descending order.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The instance status. Valid values:
- **online**: Normal service status.
- **offline**: Expired but not overdue, in an inactive state.
- **disable**: Released.
- **overdue**: Overdue payment.

parameters.name: SubscribeType
parameters.description:
The plan subscription type. Valid values:

- Free Edition (Chinese mainland): entranceplan
- Free Edition (International): entranceplan_intl
- Basic Edition: basicplan
- Standard Edition: standardplan
- Premium Edition: advancedplan
- Enterprise Edition: enterpriseplan
